documentation.name: payment
documentation.text:
A Payment transaction represents a transfer of value from one account
to another. Account defaults to the client wallet. Call signAndSubmit
to send and await success.

documentation.name: mpTokenIssuanceCreate
documentation.text:
The MPTokenIssuanceCreate transaction creates a MPTokenIssuance object
and adds it to the relevant directory node of the creator account. This
transaction is the only opportunity an issuer has to specify any token
fields that are defined as immutable (e.g., MPT Flags). If the
transaction is successful, the newly created token will be owned by the
account (the creator account) which executed the transaction. Account
defaults to the client wallet. Call signAndSubmit to send and await
success.

documentation.name: ammCreate
documentation.text:
Create a new Automated Market Maker (AMM) instance for trading a pair
of assets (fungible tokens or XRP). Account defaults to the client
wallet. Call signAndSubmit to send and await success.

documentation.name: accountInfo
documentation.text:
The `account_info` command retrieves information about an account, its
activity, and its XRP balance. All information retrieved is relative to
a particular version of the ledger. Returns an {@link * AccountInfoResponse}.

documentation.name: ledgerEntry
documentation.text:
The `ledger_entry` method returns a single ledger object from the XRP
Ledger in its raw format. Expects a response in the form of a {@link *}     * LedgerEntryResponse}.

documentation.name: tx
documentation.text:
The tx method retrieves information on a single transaction, by its
identifying hash. Expects a response in the form of a {@link * TxResponse}.

documentation.name: Amount
documentation.text:
The amount of currency to deliver. For non-XRP amounts, the nested field
names MUST be lower-case. If the tfPartialPayment flag is set, deliver up
to this amount instead.

documentation.name: Destination
documentation.text: The unique address of the account receiving the payment.

documentation.name: DestinationTag
documentation.text:
Arbitrary tag that identifies the reason for the payment to the
destination, or a hosted recipient to pay.

documentation.name: account
documentation.text: A unique identifier for the account, most commonly the account's address.

documentation.name: ledger_index
documentation.text: The ledger index of the ledger to use, or a shortcut string.

documentation.name: signAndSubmit
documentation.text: Prepare, sign and submit the draft, then wait for validated success.

documentation.name: trySignAndSubmit
documentation.text: Prepare, sign and submit, returning an explicit success/error result.

documentation.name: toJSON
documentation.text: Inspect a copy of the draft without signing or sending it.
